$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch.
$overlay-note: This build samples wof-admin for the v0.8.6-overlay (#2857). The adapter renders every name, chain and order of v0.8.5-wof-structure, and keeps a row when its hash is among the 5 lowest of its structure cell (country, tag order, name-slot kind) or of its language cell (country, name-slot language), or among the 2,500 lowest of its country. cell-counts.json beside the build counts every renderable row per cell. The WOF checkouts carry the 1,593 name fixes of whosonfirst-data/whosonfirst-data#2276.

sample.$holdOutCells-note: 30 structure cells across 20 countries, kept out of every training arm for the structure test of #2857 step 5. Each shares its tags with a kept cell of its country, so its names still train in other orders and slots.
